1.  25-55386  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Pacific Gateway Workforce
  Development Board meeting of Tuesday, February 11, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55388  Recommendation to approve the submission of the Program Year (PY) 2025 –
  2028 Regional and Local Plans, mandated by the Workforce Innovation and
  Opportunity Act (WIOA).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  America’s Job Center of California (AJCC) required partners and the Long Beach
  Workforce Innovation Network (LBWIN).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55390  Recommendation to approve Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55403  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Board Members
  Recognition of Service.
